Register players here to create your
own versus club, the @Y/"Dream Club"@.

Pick players for your Dream Club from
the @Y/"Free Player File"@ on your VMU.

Pick players for your Dream Club from
the clubs that appear in the game.

Load a Dream Club you saved earlier and
carry on choosing players to register
for the club.

Save your Dream Club data.
Currently @Y/%D players@ registered.

Only @R/%D@ registered so far.
You need @Y/8 or more@ to save.

Check the players now in your
Dream Club.

Your Dream Club has not been saved.
If you exit now, the players you chose
will be unregistered.

Choose players to register in your
Dream Club. Use the D-pad to select and
the A Button to register the player.

Players with the same name or nickname
cannot be registered together.
Please choose someone else.

Only 16 players can be registered in a
Dream Club. Remove a player via "Check
Participants" to make room.

That player is already registered in
your Dream Club.
Please choose another player.

Choose players for your Dream Club from
the preset clubs.

Choose players for your Dream Club from
J1 and J2 clubs.

Choose Dream Club players from
overseas teams.

Choose the club of the player you want
to register in your Dream Club.
D-pad to select, A Button to confirm.

Choose a player to register in your
Dream Club.
Up/Down: select, A Button: confirm.

Only 16 players can be registered in a
Dream Club. To add someone else,
please unregister a current player.

That player is already registered in
your Dream Club.
Please choose another player.

This player is in your Dream Club.
Press the B Button to remove the
selected player.

These are the current members. Put the
cursor on a player and press the B
Button to cancel their registration.
